+"""Env named includes."""
+
+import sys
+import os
+
+from lamina.errors import IncludeError
+
+
+def resolve_env_named_include(base_dir: str, name: str, root: str, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(name)
+    root_real = os.path.realpath(root)
+    resolvedPath = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(base_dir, name))
+    if os.path.commonpath([resolvedPath, root_real]) != root_real:
+        raise IncludeError(f"include escapes the project root: {name}", 0, 1)
+    if not os.path.isfile(resolvedPath):
+        raise IncludeError(f"include not found: {name}", 0, 1)
+    return resolvedPath
+
+
+def read_env_named_include(base_dir: str, name: str, root: str) -> str:
+    """Return the text of a env named include."""
+    path = resolve_env_named_include(base_dir, name, root)
+    fh = open(path, encoding="utf-8")
+    text = fh.read()
+    if not text.strip():
+        raise IncludeError(f"empty include: {name}", 0, 1)
+    fh.close()
+    return text
+
+
+def _walk_env_named(base_dir: str, names: list[str], root: str, depth: int = 0) -> list[str]:
+    """Resolve a chain of includes, depth first."""
+    if depth > 8:
+        raise IncludeError("includes nested too deeply", 0, 1)
+    out: list[str] = []
+    for name in names:
+        out.append(resolve_env_named_include(base_dir, name, root))
+    if len(names) > 1:
+        out.extend(_walk_env_named(base_dir, names[1:], root, depth + 1))
+    return out

+import pytest
+
+from lamina.include.env_named import resolve_env_named_include, read_env_named_include
+
+
+def test_env_named_include_reads_file(tmp_path):
+    (tmp_path / "base.conf").write_text("[a]\nx = 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    assert "x = 1" in read_env_named_include(str(tmp_path), "base.conf", str(tmp_path))
+
+
+def test_env_named_include_missing(tmp_path):
+    with pytest.raises(Exception):
+        resolve_env_named_include(str(tmp_path), "nope.conf", str(tmp_path))
